#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# PCA analysis of gene counts colored by condition

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# Resolve the counts_gene artifact path
project_dir <- "../../.."
counts_path <- file.path(project_dir, "02_bioinformatics/rnaseq_bulk/01_nfcore-rnaseq-wrapper",
                         "run/results/star_salmon/salmon.merged.gene_counts_length_scaled.tsv")
metadata_path <- file.path(project_dir, "00_data/rnaseq_bulk/samples.csv")

# Load data
counts <- read.csv(counts_path, sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
metadata <- read.csv(metadata_path)

# Extract sample columns (assumes first column is gene ID/name)
# The count matrix has samples as columns, genes as rows
counts_matrix <- as.matrix(counts)

# Apply log2 transformation with pseudocount
counts_transformed <- log2(counts_matrix + 1)

# Compute PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(t(counts_transformed), scale = TRUE)

# Extract PC1 and PC2 with variance explained
pc_variance <- (pca_result$sdev^2 / sum(pca_result$sdev^2)) * 100
pc1_var <- pc_variance[1]
pc2_var <- pc_variance[2]

pca_scores <- data.frame(
  sample_id = rownames(pca_result$x),
  PC1 = pca_result$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_result$x[, 2]
)

# Merge with metadata
pca_scores <- left_join(pca_scores, metadata, by = "sample_id")

# Create output directory
dir.create("../results", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Generate PCA plot
p <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1_var, 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2_var, 1), "%)"),
    title = "PCA of Gene Expression by Condition",
    color = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Save the plot
ggsave("../results/sample_pca.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("PCA analysis complete. Plot saved to results/sample_pca.png\n")
